```{r setup, echo = F, warning = F, message = F}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = T, echo = F, message = F, warning = F)
library(seafisheries)
library(longlineTypology)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)

source(here::here("workflows", "config", "config_alb.R"))

sp   <- tolower(species)
sp_n <- paste0(sp, "_n")
sp_w <- paste0(sp, "_w")

# Inputs: outputs of longline.qmd
inp <- function(file) {
	f <- file.path(save_folder, file)
	if (!file.exists(f)) stop("Missing input ", f, ": run longline.qmd first")
	readRDS(f)
}
out_folder <- file.path(save_folder, "LL_fisheries", fisheries_tag)
dir.create(out_folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
saveIt <- function(obj, file, folder = out_folder) {
	if (save_it) saveRDS(obj, file.path(folder, file))
	invisible(obj)
}
source(here::here("workflows", "R", "diag_helpers.R"))

if (!file.exists(cluster_file)) stop("Cluster file not found: ", cluster_file)
cluster_diag <- readRDS(cluster_file)
scenario     <- cluster_diag$scenario
clust_vars   <- cluster_diag$pca_select
fit_years    <- if (is.null(assign_fit_years)) cluster_diag$fit_years else assign_fit_years

diagAdd("tables", "settings", data.frame(
	setting = c("cluster file", "scenario", "variables", "K", "merged", "assignment",
				"prior", "prior tiers", "reference years"),
	value = c(cluster_file, scenario, paste(clust_vars, collapse = ", "), k_opr,
			  if (is.null(merge_clusters)) "none" else
			  	paste(names(merge_clusters), sapply(merge_clusters, paste, collapse = "+"), sep = " <- ", collapse = "; "),
			  assign_method, assign_prior,
			  paste(sapply(assign_prior_tiers, paste, collapse = " x "), collapse = " > "),
			  paste(fit_years, collapse = "-"))))
knitr::kable(.diag$tables$settings, caption = "Settings")
```

# Operational fisheries

The fisheries are the clusters of the longlineTypology run in `cluster_file`.
Monthly operational records (vessel x month x 1 deg cell) with every
clustering variable get the nearest k-means centroid. The others (no valid
HBF) are assigned by discriminant analysis on the variables they have, with
the complete records as reference.

```{r opr_kmeans}
opr <- inp("LL_EC_LF_mm.RDS") |>
	assignment_vars(scenario, lat_col = "latitude")

opr$cluster_km <- apply_clusters(opr, cluster_diag, k_opr, merge = merge_clusters)
label_map <- attr(opr$cluster_km, "label_map")
nb_f_opr  <- max(label_map$cluster)
complete  <- !is.na(opr$cluster_km)

diagAdd("tables", "label_map", label_map)
diagAdd("tables", "input_check", attr(opr$cluster_km, "input_check"))
if (!all(.diag$tables$input_check$ok))
	diagWarn("apply_clusters", "variables differing from the clustering data: ",
			 paste(.diag$tables$input_check$variable[!.diag$tables$input_check$ok], collapse = ", "))
knitr::kable(.diag$tables$input_check,
			 caption = "Complete records of the fit years scaled with the clustering parameters (expected mean 0, sd 1)")
knitr::kable(label_map, caption = "Cluster numbers: saved, after merging, fishery")
```

```{r opr_fit}
yr  <- year(opr$ymd)
ref <- complete & yr >= fit_years[1] & yr <= fit_years[2]

fit <- fit_assignment(opr[ref, ], opr$cluster_km[ref], vars = clust_vars,
					  prior = assign_prior, prior_tiers = assign_prior_tiers,
					  prior_min_n = assign_prior_min_n, scenario = scenario)
fit
```

## How well does the assignment work?

Tested on the reference records, whose fishery is known (in-sample: with
`r format(sum(ref), big.mark = ",")` records the optimism is negligible,
except for small flag x year priors). Accuracies are weighted by effort.

1. All variables: agreement between the discriminant analysis and the k-means
   assignment. Low agreement means the discriminant analysis does not
   describe these clusters well, and the next tests are not reliable.
2. HBF hidden: how well records without HBF are assigned, by prior.

```{r opr_checks}
chk_all <- check_assignment(fit, opr[ref, ], opr$cluster_km[ref], weight_col = "E",
							method = assign_method)

hide_vars <- intersect(c("mean_hbf", "hbf_cat"), clust_vars)
priors <- unique(c("equal", "global", assign_prior))
chk_hide <- lapply(priors, function(pr)
	check_assignment(fit, opr[ref, ], opr$cluster_km[ref], hide = hide_vars, weight_col = "E",
					 by = "flag", method = assign_method, prior = pr))
names(chk_hide) <- priors

acc <- data.frame(test = c("all variables", paste0(paste(hide_vars, collapse = ", "), " hidden, prior ", priors)),
				  accuracy = round(unname(c(chk_all$accuracy, sapply(chk_hide, `[[`, "accuracy"))), 4))
diagAdd("tables", "assignment_accuracy", acc)
knitr::kable(acc, caption = "Share of effort assigned to its k-means fishery")

chk <- chk_hide[[assign_prior]]
diagAdd("tables", "assignment_by_fishery", chk$by_cluster)
conf <- as.data.frame.matrix(chk$confusion)
conf <- cbind(kmeans = rownames(conf), conf)
diagAdd("tables", "assignment_confusion", conf)
knitr::kable(chk$by_cluster, caption = paste0("HBF hidden, prior ", assign_prior, ": recall and precision per fishery"))
knitr::kable(conf, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE,
			 caption = "HBF hidden: k-means fishery (rows) vs assigned (columns), share of effort")
```

Calibration: if the assignment probability is reliable, the accuracy of each
probability class is close to its mean probability. The mean probability of
the records actually assigned is then an estimate of their accuracy, with
their own prior and variables (valid only if records without HBF look like
the complete records of the same fishery, which this test cannot check).

```{r opr_calibration}
diagAdd("tables", "assignment_calibration", chk$calibration)
knitr::kable(chk$calibration, caption = "HBF hidden: accuracy by class of assignment probability")

# by decade, for the flags with the most assigned effort: a flag reporting HBF
# in some decades only can be accurate overall and wrong for the years assigned.
# All complete records, not only the reference years: the decades outside them
# are an out-of-sample test.
chk_dec <- check_assignment(fit, opr[complete, ], opr$cluster_km[complete], hide = hide_vars, weight_col = "E",
							by = c("flag", "decade"), method = assign_method, prior = assign_prior)
```

## Assigning the incomplete records
## Assigning the incomplete records

```{r opr_assign}
a_opr <- assign_records(fit, opr[!complete, ], method = assign_method, prior = assign_prior)

opr$f <- opr$cluster_km
opr$f[!complete] <- a_opr$cluster
opr$f_source <- ifelse(complete, "kmeans", ifelse(is.na(opr$f), "none", "assigned"))
opr$f_prob <- 1
opr$f_prob[!complete] <- a_opr$prob

f_summary <- opr |>
	group_by(f, f_source) |>
	summarise(records = n(), effort = sum(E), catch = sum(.data[[sp_w]], na.rm = TRUE),
			  low_prob = sum(f_prob < 0.8, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
	mutate(effort_share = round(effort / sum(effort), 4))
diagAdd("tables", "opr_fisheries", as.data.frame(f_summary))
diagAdd("tables", "opr_prior_tiers", as.data.frame(table(prior_tier = a_opr$prior_tier, useNA = "ifany")))
if (any(is.na(opr$f)))
	diagWarn("operational fisheries", sum(is.na(opr$f)), " monthly records without any assignment variable")
knitr::kable(f_summary, caption = paste0("Operational fisheries; low_prob: assigned with probability < 0.8; catch: ", species, " (mt)"))

saveIt(opr |> dplyr::select(row_id, f, f_source, f_prob), "LL_opr_fisheries.RDS")
```

Expected accuracy of the assigned records: their mean assignment probability,
weighted by effort, next to the accuracy of the same flag in the HBF-hidden test.

```{r opr_expected_accuracy}
asg <- opr[!complete & !is.na(opr$f), ]
exp_by <- function(d, g) d |>
	group_by(across(all_of(g))) |>
	summarise(assigned_effort = sum(E), expected_accuracy = round(sum(E * f_prob) / sum(E), 4),
			  low_prob_effort = round(sum(E[f_prob < 0.8]) / sum(E), 4), .groups = "drop")

exp_all <- data.frame(assigned_effort = sum(asg$E),
					  pct_of_effort = round(100 * sum(asg$E) / sum(opr$E), 2),
					  expected_accuracy = round(sum(asg$E * asg$f_prob) / sum(asg$E), 4))
exp_f <- exp_by(asg, "f")
exp_flag <- opr |>
	group_by(flag) |>
	summarise(effort = sum(E), pct_assigned = round(100 * sum(E[f_source == "assigned"]) / sum(E), 1),
			  .groups = "drop") |>
	left_join(exp_by(asg, "flag"), by = "flag") |>
	left_join(chk$by_group |> dplyr::select(flag, test_accuracy = accuracy), by = "flag") |>
	arrange(desc(assigned_effort))

# decades of the 10 flags with the most assigned effort
top_flags <- head(exp_flag$flag[!is.na(exp_flag$assigned_effort)], 10)
asg$decade <- 10L * (year(asg$ymd) %/% 10L)
exp_dec <- exp_by(asg |> filter(flag %in% top_flags), c("flag", "decade")) |>
	mutate(key = paste(flag, decade, sep = " | ")) |>
	left_join(chk_dec$by_group |> rename(key = `flag | decade`) |>
			  	dplyr::select(key, test_accuracy = accuracy), by = "key") |>
	dplyr::select(-key) |>
	arrange(flag, decade)

diagAdd("tables", "assigned_expected_accuracy", exp_all)
diagAdd("tables", "assigned_by_fishery", as.data.frame(exp_f))
diagAdd("tables", "assigned_by_flag", as.data.frame(exp_flag))
diagAdd("tables", "assigned_by_flag_decade", as.data.frame(exp_dec))
knitr::kable(exp_all, caption = "Assigned records: share of effort and expected accuracy")
knitr::kable(exp_f, caption = "Assigned records per fishery: expected accuracy and share of effort with probability < 0.8")
knitr::kable(exp_flag, caption = "Per flag: assigned effort, expected accuracy, and accuracy in the HBF-hidden test")
knitr::kable(exp_dec, caption = "Flags with the most assigned effort, per decade (test_accuracy: all complete records of that decade; NA: none)")
```

```{r opr_ec}
EC_f_opr <- opr |>
	filter(!is.na(f)) |>
	mutate(yr = year(ymd), mm = month(ymd), dd = 1, gr = "L", res = 1) |>
	rename(lon = longitude, lat = latitude) |>
	dplyr::select(f, yr, mm, dd, gr, lat, lon, res, E, C = all_of(sp_w)) |>
	mutate(CPUE = ifelse(E > 0, C / E, 0))

saveIt(EC_f_opr, "LL_EC_opr_f.RDS")
```

## Length frequencies of the operational fisheries

Each measured fish is routed to the monthly record(s) its sample was matched
to in longline.qmd, with the matching weights, then to that record's fishery.

```{r opr_lf}
LF_dat          <- inp("LL_LF_opr.RDS")
CE_dat_mean_len <- inp("CE_dat_mean_len.RDS")
EC_LF_month     <- inp("LL_EC_LF_opr_mm.RDS")
EC_dat_IDed     <- inp("EC_dat_IDed_subsetcols.RDS")

# fishery, time and position of each monthly record
EC_f_opr_key <- opr |>
	mutate(yr = year(ymd), mm = month(ymd), qtr = quarter(ymd)) |>
	rename(lon = longitude, lat = latitude) |>
	dplyr::select(row_id, f, yr, mm, qtr, lat, lon, all_of(sp_n), flag)

res_d <- 1

# lengths capped to the global bounds, one count per sample id and length
LF_count <- LF_dat |>
	mutate(len = pmin(pmax(len, min_len), max_len)) |>
	group_by(id, len) |>
	summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

# observer match: weight_direct; next port sample of the trip: weight_portsampling
id_row_weight <- CE_dat_mean_len |>
	filter(match_type %in% c("flag-vesselname-date-observer",
							 "same_continuous_trip-next_portsampling_measure"),
		   !is.na(id)) |>
	mutate(ymd_month = make_date(year(ymd), month(ymd), 15),
		   weight = ifelse(match_type == "flag-vesselname-date-observer",
		   				weight_direct, weight_portsampling)) |>
	group_by(flag, vesselname, ymd_month, latCent, lonCent, id) |>
	summarise(weight = sum(weight, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

row_id_to_id <- EC_LF_month |>
	dplyr::select(row_id, flag, vesselname, ymd, latitude, longitude) |>
	rename(ymd_month = ymd, latCent = latitude, lonCent = longitude) |>
	inner_join(id_row_weight, by = c("flag", "vesselname", "ymd_month", "latCent", "lonCent"))

LF_row_count <- row_id_to_id |>
	left_join(LF_count, by = "id", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
	filter(!is.na(len)) |>
	mutate(count = count * weight) |>
	group_by(row_id, len) |>
	summarise(count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

LF_LLdet <- LF_row_count |>
	left_join(EC_f_opr_key, by = "row_id") |>
	filter(!is.na(f)) |>
	group_by(yr, mm, qtr, f, lat, lon, len) |>
	summarise(count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
	mutate(lon_from = lon - res_d / 2, lon_to = lon + res_d / 2,
		   lat_from = lat - res_d / 2, lat_to = lat + res_d / 2) |>
	dplyr::select(-lon, -lat) |>
	arrange(yr, mm, f, lat_from, lon_from, len)

saveIt(LF_LLdet, "LL_LF_opr_f.RDS")
```

```{r opr_lf_checks}
# Structural checks: must be 0
n_dupe_keys <- id_row_weight |> count(flag, vesselname, ymd_month, latCent, lonCent, id) |>
	filter(n > 1) |> nrow()
n_bad_weight_groups <- EC_dat_IDed |>
	filter(match_type == "flag-vesselname-date-observer") |>
	group_by(id_obs) |>
	summarise(total_weight = sum(weight_direct, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
	filter(abs(total_weight - 1) > 1e-6) |> nrow()
n_leaked <- sum(!is.na(EC_dat_IDed$weight_direct) &
					EC_dat_IDed$match_type != "flag-vesselname-date-observer", na.rm = TRUE)
weight_sanity <- id_row_weight |> group_by(id) |> summarise(total_weight = sum(weight), .groups = "drop")
n_overweight <- sum(weight_sanity$total_weight > 1.1)
n_lf_no_ec <- sum(!(unique(LF_row_count$row_id) %in% EC_f_opr_key$row_id))

structural <- data.frame(
	check = c("duplicated (record, sample) keys", "observer samples with weights not summing to 1",
			  "observer weights outside observer matches", "samples counted more than once (weight > 1.1)",
			  "matched records missing from the fishery table"),
	n = c(n_dupe_keys, n_bad_weight_groups, n_leaked, n_overweight, n_lf_no_ec))
for (i in which(structural$n > 0))
	diagWarn("length routing", structural$check[i], ": ", structural$n[i])
diagAdd("tables", "lf_routing_structural", structural)

# Conservation: fish routed to a fishery vs fish measured, and why the others are not
raw_total    <- sum(LF_count$count)
routed_total <- sum(LF_row_count$count)
unmatched_ids <- LF_count |> group_by(id) |> summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop") |>
	filter(!(id %in% id_row_weight$id))
by_source <- LF_dat |> filter(id %in% unmatched_ids$id) |> distinct(id, data_source) |>
	left_join(unmatched_ids, by = "id") |> group_by(data_source) |>
	summarise(samples = n(), fish = sum(count), .groups = "drop")
diagAdd("tables", "lf_routing_conservation", data.frame(
	fish_measured = raw_total, fish_routed = round(routed_total),
	pct_routed = round(100 * routed_total / raw_total, 1),
	samples_partial = sum(weight_sanity$total_weight > 0 & weight_sanity$total_weight < 0.99)))
diagAdd("tables", "lf_routing_unmatched", as.data.frame(by_source))

knitr::kable(structural, caption = "Length routing: structural checks (must be 0)")
knitr::kable(.diag$tables$lf_routing_conservation, caption = "Length routing: fish measured vs routed to a fishery")
knitr::kable(by_source, caption = "Samples never matched to an operational record, by source")
```

# Raised fisheries

Raised records (flag x month x 5 deg cell) have the species composition and
latitude but no HBF. They are assigned with the same model as the incomplete
operational records, using the cell centre latitude.

## How well does it work on raised-like data?

Operational reference records are aggregated to raised strata and assigned;
the reference fishery of a stratum is the one with the most effort.
`purity` is its effort share: a stratum of purity 0.5 is half another
fishery, and no single assignment can be right for it.

```{r rai_check}
chk_strata <- check_strata_assignment(fit, opr[ref, ], opr$cluster_km[ref], res = 5,
									  method = assign_method, prior = assign_prior)
diagAdd("tables", "strata_accuracy", data.frame(accuracy = round(chk_strata$accuracy, 4)))
diagAdd("tables", "strata_by_purity", chk_strata$by_purity)
diagAdd("tables", "strata_by_fishery", chk_strata$by_cluster)
knitr::kable(chk_strata$by_purity, digits = 3,
			 caption = paste0("Aggregated reference records: accuracy by purity (overall ",
			 				 round(100 * chk_strata$accuracy, 1), "% of effort)"))
knitr::kable(chk_strata$by_cluster, caption = "Aggregated reference records: recall and precision per fishery")
```

```{r rai_assign}
rai <- inp("LL_EC_rai.RDS") |>
	assignment_vars(scenario, lat_col = "latCent")
a_rai <- assign_records(fit, rai, method = assign_method, prior = assign_prior)
rai$cluster <- a_rai$cluster
rai$f_prob  <- a_rai$prob

rai_summary <- rai |>
	group_by(cluster) |>
	summarise(records = n(), effort = sum(E), catch = sum(.data[[sp_w]], na.rm = TRUE),
			  low_prob = sum(f_prob < 0.8, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
	mutate(effort_share = round(effort / sum(effort), 4))
diagAdd("tables", "rai_fisheries", as.data.frame(rai_summary))
diagAdd("tables", "rai_prior_tiers", as.data.frame(table(prior_tier = a_rai$prior_tier, useNA = "ifany")))
knitr::kable(rai_summary, caption = paste0("Raised records by fishery (NA: no catch in numbers); catch: ", species, " (mt)"))
```

## Delta: raised minus operational

The delta is the raised catch and effort missing from the operational
records, per flag x month x 5 deg cell. The operational side is exactly the
operational fishery records above, so that the outputs add up.

1. Reconciliation, per flag x year and per variable (effort, each catch
   column): cells where the logbooks exceed the raised data reduce the delta
   of the other cells of the flag-year, so that operational + delta = raised.
   Flag-years where the logbooks exceed the raised total get no delta; the
   logbooks are kept and the excess is reported.
2. Cells with a delta but delta effort <= `thr_E` are set aside as dummy
   (no effort to attach a catch rate to); they count in the totals.
3. Fishery: where the logbooks cover at least `assign_delta_coverage` of the
   cell's raised effort, the delta is split like the logbook fisheries of the
   cell (effort shares for effort, catch shares for catch). Elsewhere it
   takes the fishery with the most assigned raised effort in the cell.
   Delta fisheries are numbered after the operational ones (`nb_f_opr` + fishery).

```{r delta}
catch_cols <- as.vector(outer(species_all, c("_n", "_w"), paste0))
vars_d <- c("E", catch_cols)
key <- c("flag", "latCent", "lonCent", "ymd")

# operational fishery records at the raised resolution
opr_f5 <- opr |>
	filter(!is.na(f)) |>
	mutate(latCent = roundTo2.5(latitude), lonCent = roundTo2.5(longitude),
		   ymd = make_date(year(ymd), month(ymd), 15)) |>
	group_by(across(all_of(c(key, "f")))) |>
	summarise(across(all_of(vars_d), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")

# fishery of each raised cell: the one with the most assigned raised effort
maj <- rai |>
	filter(!is.na(cluster)) |>
	group_by(across(all_of(key)), cluster) |>
	summarise(E_f = sum(E), .groups = "drop_last") |>
	mutate(purity = E_f / sum(E_f)) |>
	slice_max(E_f, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
	ungroup() |>
	dplyr::select(-E_f)

rec <- reconcile_delta(raised = rai, operational = opr_f5, key = key, vars = vars_d,
					   group = assign_delta_group, effort_col = "E", thr_E = thr_E)

EC_delta_dummy <- rec$cells |> filter(type == "dummy")
delta_split <- split_delta(rec$cells |> filter(type == "delta"),
						   operational = opr_f5 |> rename(cluster = f),
						   raised_fishery = maj, key = key, vars = vars_d,
						   coverage_threshold = assign_delta_coverage)

# no fishery: no logbook mix and no assigned raised record in the cell
EC_delta_unassigned <- delta_split |> filter(is.na(cluster))

EC_f_raidelta <- delta_split |>
	filter(!is.na(cluster)) |>
	mutate(qtr = quarter(ymd), latitude = latCent, longitude = lonCent,
		   f = nb_f_opr + as.numeric(cluster),
		   row_id = row_number())
EC_f_raidelta$total_n <- rowSums(EC_f_raidelta[, paste0(species_all, "_n")])
EC_f_raidelta$total_w <- rowSums(EC_f_raidelta[, paste0(species_all, "_w")])
for (s in species_all)
	EC_f_raidelta[[paste0(s, "_fraction")]] <- ifelse(EC_f_raidelta$total_w > 0,
		EC_f_raidelta[[paste0(s, "_w")]] / EC_f_raidelta$total_w,
		ifelse(EC_f_raidelta$total_n > 0, EC_f_raidelta[[paste0(s, "_n")]] / EC_f_raidelta$total_n, NA_real_))

saveIt(EC_f_raidelta, "LL_EC_f_raidelta.RDS")
saveIt(EC_delta_dummy, "LL_EC_raidelta_dummy.RDS")
saveIt(EC_delta_unassigned, "LL_EC_raidelta_unassigned.RDS")
saveIt(rec$groups, "LL_delta_groups.RDS")
```

```{r delta_diag}
# Totals: raised vs operational + delta + dummy (+ unassigned), for effort and
# the species catch
tot <- function(d, v) sum(d[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)
check_tot <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("E", sp_n, sp_w), function(v) {
	g <- rec$groups[rec$groups$variable == v, ]
	data.frame(variable = v, raised = tot(rai, v), operational = tot(opr_f5, v),
			   delta = tot(EC_f_raidelta, v), unassigned = tot(EC_delta_unassigned, v),
			   dummy = tot(EC_delta_dummy, v), overshoot = sum(g$overshoot))
})) |>
	mutate(outputs = operational + delta + unassigned + dummy,
		   difference = outputs - raised,
		   difference_minus_overshoot = round(difference - overshoot, 3))
if (any(abs(check_tot$difference_minus_overshoot) > 1e-6 * pmax(1, check_tot$raised)))
	diagWarn("delta", "operational + delta + dummy differs from raised beyond the reported overshoot")
diagAdd("tables", "delta_totals", check_tot)
knitr::kable(check_tot, digits = 1, caption = paste0(
	"Totals (effort in hundreds of hooks, ", species, " catch in numbers and mt): outputs - raised = overshoot (flag-years where the logbooks exceed raised)"))

# Overshoot: flag-years where the logbooks exceed the raised data
os <- rec$groups |> filter(variable == sp_w, overshoot > 0) |>
	arrange(desc(overshoot)) |>
	dplyr::select(flag, year, raised, operational, overshoot)
diagAdd("tables", "delta_overshoot", as.data.frame(os))
if (nrow(os))
	diagWarn("delta", nrow(os), " flag-years where the logbooks exceed the raised ", species, " catch (",
			 round(sum(os$overshoot), 1), " mt in total): logbooks kept, no delta")
knitr::kable(head(os, 30), digits = 1, caption = paste0(
	"Flag-years where the logbook ", species, " catch exceeds the raised catch (30 largest)"))

# How the delta got its fishery
src <- delta_split |>
	mutate(delta_source = ifelse(is.na(delta_source), "unassigned", delta_source)) |>
	group_by(delta_source) |>
	summarise(cells = n_distinct(paste(flag, latCent, lonCent, ymd)), effort = sum(E),
			  catch = sum(.data[[sp_w]]), .groups = "drop") |>
	mutate(catch_share = round(catch / sum(catch), 4))
diagAdd("tables", "delta_sources", as.data.frame(src))
knitr::kable(src, digits = 1, caption = paste0(
	"Delta by origin of its fishery (catch: ", species, ", mt); logbook mix from coverage >= ",
	assign_delta_coverage))

# Per flag and per year
by_g <- function(cols) {
	r <- rai |> mutate(year = year(ymd)) |> group_by(across(all_of(cols))) |>
		summarise(raised = sum(.data[[sp_w]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
	o <- opr_f5 |> mutate(year = year(ymd)) |> group_by(across(all_of(cols))) |>
		summarise(operational = sum(.data[[sp_w]]), .groups = "drop")
	d <- EC_f_raidelta |> mutate(year = year(ymd)) |> group_by(across(all_of(cols))) |>
		summarise(delta = sum(.data[[sp_w]]), .groups = "drop")
	u <- bind_rows(EC_delta_dummy, EC_delta_unassigned) |> mutate(year = year(ymd)) |>
		group_by(across(all_of(cols))) |>
		summarise(dummy_unassigned = sum(.data[[sp_w]]), .groups = "drop")
	full_join(r, o, by = cols) |> full_join(d, by = cols) |> full_join(u, by = cols) |>
		mutate(across(c(raised, operational, delta, dummy_unassigned), ~ replace(.x, is.na(.x), 0)),
			   overshoot = operational + delta + dummy_unassigned - raised)
}
flag_summary <- by_g("flag") |> arrange(desc(raised))
year_summary <- by_g("year")
diagAdd("tables", "delta_by_flag", as.data.frame(flag_summary))
diagAdd("tables", "delta_by_year", as.data.frame(year_summary))
knitr::kable(flag_summary, digits = 1, caption = paste0(species, " catch (mt) per flag"))

bind_rows(
	year_summary |> transmute(year, C = raised, source = "Raised"),
	year_summary |> transmute(year, C = operational + delta + dummy_unassigned, source = "Operational + delta")) |>
	ggplot(aes(x = year, y = C, colour = source)) +
	geom_line() +
	labs(x = "Year", y = paste(species, "catch (mt)"), colour = NULL) +
	theme_minimal()
```

## Length frequencies of the raised fisheries

Aggregated length samples are split between the operational and delta
fisheries present in their region (flag x quarter), in proportion to their
catch in numbers.

```{r rai_lf}
LF_uniform_bins <- inp("LL_LF_uniform.RDS")
LFr_regions     <- inp("LFr_regions.RDS")

EC_f_raidelta_key <- EC_f_raidelta |>
	mutate(yr = year(ymd), qtr = quarter(ymd)) |>
	rename(lon = longitude, lat = latitude) |>
	dplyr::select(f, yr, qtr, lat, lon, all_of(sp_n), flag)

LFr_binned <- LF_uniform_bins |>
	mutate(len = pmin(pmax(len, min_len), max_len)) |>
	inner_join(LFr_regions |>
			   	dplyr::select(ASTRAT, lat_region, lon_region, lat_from, lat_to, lon_from, lon_to, id_region),
			   by = c("ASTRAT", "latCent" = "lat_region", "lonCent" = "lon_region")) |>
	group_by(id_region, flag, yr, qtr, lat_from, lat_to, lon_from, lon_to, len) |>
	summarise(count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

box_keys <- LFr_binned |> distinct(id_region, flag, yr, qtr, lat_from, lat_to, lon_from, lon_to)

# operational records inside each box (<=), delta records inside (strict <, 5 deg centres)
det_n <- box_keys |>
	left_join(EC_f_opr_key, by = c("flag", "yr", "qtr"), relationship = "many-to-many") |>
	filter(lon_from <= lon, lon_to >= lon, lat_from <= lat, lat_to >= lat) |>
	group_by(id_region, flag, yr, qtr, f) |>
	summarise(n = sum(.data[[sp_n]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
rai_n <- box_keys |>
	left_join(EC_f_raidelta_key, by = c("flag", "yr", "qtr"), relationship = "many-to-many") |>
	filter(lon_from < lon, lon_to > lon, lat_from < lat, lat_to > lat) |>
	group_by(id_region, flag, yr, qtr, f) |>
	summarise(n = sum(.data[[sp_n]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

wf <- bind_rows(det_n, rai_n) |>
	group_by(id_region, flag, yr, qtr, f) |>
	summarise(n = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
	filter(n > 0) |>
	group_by(id_region, flag, yr, qtr) |>
	mutate(w = n / sum(n)) |>
	ungroup() |>
	dplyr::select(-n)

LF_LLrai <- LFr_binned |>
	left_join(wf, by = c("id_region", "flag", "yr", "qtr"), relationship = "many-to-many") |>
	filter(!is.na(f)) |>
	mutate(count = count * w) |>
	group_by(yr, qtr, f, lon_from, lon_to, lat_from, lat_to, len) |>
	summarise(count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
	mutate(mm = qtr * 3 - 1) |>
	arrange(yr, qtr, f, lon_from, lat_from, len)

diagAdd("tables", "lf_raised_routing", data.frame(
	fish_measured = round(sum(LFr_binned$count)), fish_routed = round(sum(LF_LLrai$count))) |>
	mutate(pct_routed = round(100 * fish_routed / fish_measured, 1)))
knitr::kable(.diag$tables$lf_raised_routing,
			 caption = "Aggregated lengths routed to a fishery (the others: no catch of the species in their region)")

saveIt(LF_LLrai, "LL_LF_rai_f.RDS")
```

# Hampel filter

```{r hampel}
# apply_hampel() prints a summary per fishery: captured in the diagnostics
hampelCE <- function(d) do.call(apply_hampel, c(list(df = d, type = "CE"), hampel_EC))
hampelLF <- function(d) do.call(apply_hampel, c(list(df = d, type = "LF"), hampel_LF))

EC_f_hampel_opr <- runStep(EC_f_opr, "hampel_EC_opr", "Hampel filter", hampelCE)
saveIt(EC_f_hampel_opr, "LL_EC_hampel_opr.RDS")

EC_f_raidelta_fmt <- EC_f_raidelta |>
	mutate(yr = year(ymd), mm = month(ymd), dd = 1, gr = "L", res = 5) |>
	rename(lon = longitude, lat = latitude) |>
	dplyr::select(f, yr, mm, dd, gr, lat, lon, res, E, C = all_of(sp_w)) |>
	mutate(CPUE = ifelse(E > 0, C / E, 0))
EC_f_hampel_raidelta <- runStep(EC_f_raidelta_fmt, "hampel_EC_delta", "Hampel filter", hampelCE)
saveIt(EC_f_hampel_raidelta, "LL_EC_hampel_raidelta.RDS")

LF_f_hampel_opr <- runStep(LF_LLdet, "hampel_LF_opr", "Hampel filter", hampelLF)
saveIt(LF_f_hampel_opr, "LL_LF_hampel_opr.RDS")
LF_f_hampel_rai <- runStep(LF_LLrai, "hampel_LF_rai", "Hampel filter", hampelLF)
saveIt(LF_f_hampel_rai, "LL_LF_hampel_rai.RDS")

knitr::kable(stepsTable()[grepl("^hampel", stepsTable()$dataset), ], row.names = FALSE, caption = "Hampel filter")
```

# Fisheries

```{r fisheries_table}
fisheries <- bind_rows(
	data.frame(f = sort(unique(EC_f_opr$f)), type = "operational") |> mutate(cluster = f),
	data.frame(f = sort(unique(EC_f_raidelta$f)), type = "delta") |> mutate(cluster = f - nb_f_opr)) |>
	left_join(bind_rows(EC_f_hampel_opr, EC_f_hampel_raidelta) |> group_by(f) |>
			  	summarise(records = n(), effort = sum(E), catch = sum(C, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
			  by = "f")
diagAdd("tables", "fisheries", fisheries)
knitr::kable(fisheries, digits = 1, caption = paste0("Fisheries after the Hampel filter; catch: ", species, " (mt)"))
saveIt(fisheries, "LL_fisheries_table.RDS")

diagnostics <- list(
	species = species, request_tag = request_tag, rendered = Sys.time(),
	steps = stepsTable(), messages = .diag$messages, warnings = .diag$warnings,
	tables = .diag$tables)
saveIt(diagnostics, "LL_fisheries_diagnostics.RDS")
```
